title: ASR Under the Stethoscope: Evaluating Biases in Clinical Speech Recognition across Indian Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Word Error Rate (WER) and its components (substitution, deletion, and insertion) across English, Hindi, and Kannada speech.
Comparing Word Error Rate (WER) between clinician/doctor speech and patient speech during clinical interviews.
Evaluating the differences in Word Error Rate (WER) of ASR models between male and female speakers.
Analyzing Word Error Rate (WER) across the intersection of gender and speaker roles (e.g., comparing female doctors, male patients, female patients, and male doctors).
Comparing Word Error Rate (WER) based on the patient's education level, categorized as 'below graduation' versus 'graduation or above'.

Evaluating disparities in Word Error Rate (WER) across speakers from different native geographical regions of India (Central, East, North, Northeast, South, West) to assess the impact of regional accents and prosody.
